provenance: v3 mix-and-match enclosure (open-flight/openflight-enclosure PR #9; parts Front-Camera-Sound-Detector, Front-Radar, Screen-1024x600, Shell-x12-a1 dc-jack, Feet-Adjustable, x1209 Pi adapter), as built and measured by Harjot 2026-09-22 on the OpenFlight Pi 5 unit. Offsets supplied in an (X lateral, Y forward, Z up) frame relative to the camera and converted to camera image axes (+x image-right = target-right, +y down, +z forward from the lens front vertex): reported X was the observer's right while FACING the enclosure from the front, i.e. target-LEFT, so mic and OPS x are negated. iwr_offset is the centre of the 4-RX antenna row. Camera boresight level (0 deg); IWR and OPS share a mount aimed 10 deg up; shell stands level so housing_tilt is 0 and the LIS3DH, lying flat on the shell floor parallel to the base, should read 0 pitch and 0 roll when correctly placed. focal_px is the nominal 2.8 mm lens over the 2x-decimated 6.0 um effective pitch for the 320x200 mode and is PENDING checkerboard calibration; principal point and distortion uncalibrated. lens_height_above_floor_mm is at the default Feet-Adjustable extension and moves with the feet. Derived RX-row height above floor = 51 mm. Does NOT describe session 20260825_181734 (a different, unmeasured enclosure) or the v42 design. On this unit the LIS3DH's +Y arrow points to the BACK of the enclosure (checked by Harjot 2026-09-23; the camera, the tape and the inclinometer agreed on a 3.3 deg tilt with opposite signs), so lis3dh_mount_yaw_deg is 180: X and Y read reversed until the board is turned round.
